description: Builds the transactions for one action, ready for `from`’s own wallet to sign and send in order on Robinhood Chain: buy or sell (amount, optional slippage_bps, accept_impact and market: by default the trade goes to the market that gives more, the Civic Pool through CivicRouter with a ten-minute deadline, or Semiosis’s Pons launch curve directly, where the minimum out is the only limit, validUntil is null and the `to` is the curve that get_contracts lists under outside; market civic keeps it on CivicRouter; a sale approves exactly its amount), stake or unstake (amount), claim_pass, borrow (amount of Semiosis to lock), repay or extend (loan_id), delegate (to, or itself when left out), vote (proposal_id, support), and the public duties sweep_pool_fees, pay_stakers and close_expired_loan (loan_id). amount may be "max". Nothing is signed or sent here. A lone transaction is first run as an eth_call from `from`, and one that would fail is refused with the reason; an approval is added only when the allowance falls short.

accept_impact.description: Accept a trade that loses 15% or more of its value to price impact (buy and sell).

amount.description: In whole units as a decimal string, or "max": ETH for buy; Semiosis for sell, stake, unstake and borrow.

from.description: The address that will sign and send the transactions.

loan_id.description: A loan’s id as a string, such as "3" (repay, extend, close_expired_loan).

market.description: Where to trade. auto (the default) quotes the Civic Pool and Semiosis’s Pons launch curve at the same block and uses the one that gives more; the Civic Pool keeps a near tie (within 0.5%), since its fee goes to the treasury, and a buy that would close the curve is never sent to it (the quote gives markets.pons.maxBuyEth). civic or pons uses that market; civic keeps every trade on the CivicRouter, with its deadline. (buy and sell)

proposal_id.description: A proposal’s id as get_proposals gives it (vote).

slippage_bps.description: Slippage in basis points, 1 to 500 (100 = 1%). Default 100.

to.description: Who votes with this stake (delegate); `from` itself when left out.

name: build_transaction
title: Build a transaction
